Anna Thomason-Kenyon

Cornish Independent Nonaligned GroupConstantine, Mabe & Mawnan
cllr.anna.thomason-kenyon@cornwall.gov.uk
RSS FeedReport CardCompare

Anna Thomason‑Kenyon serves as a councillor for the Constantine, Mabe & Mawnan ward on Cornwall Council, representing the Cornish Independent Nonaligned Group. In her capacity she sits on a number of committees, including the Constitution and Governance Committee, the Corporate Finance and Performance Overview and Scrutiny Committee, the Miscellaneous Licensing Committee, the Urgent Driver/Operator/Vehicle Sub‑Committee, the West Sub‑Area Planning Committee and the full Cornwall Council body.

During the 2021‑2022 reporting period she attended 21 of 22 council meetings, achieving an attendance rate of 95.5 %. No conduct cases have been recorded against her, and there is no expense data available. The council’s monitoring system has flagged one active red‑flag indicator classified as “slim_majority.” Media coverage of the councillor is absent, and an election vulnerability score of 74 out of 100 reflects her narrow re‑election margin of 13 votes (0.72 % of the total vote) with a required swing of 0.36 % to lose the seat.

Election History

VulnerableScore: 74/100→ Stable
Won by 13 votes (0.7%)0.4% swing needed to unseat

Councillor Anna Thomason‑Kenyon was re‑elected with a razor‑thin majority of 13 votes, representing just 0.72 % of the total vote and a required swing of only 0.36 % to lose the seat. The margin has shrunk dramatically, with the gap narrowing by 24.4 percentage points compared with the 2021 result, and turnout was low at 41.92 %. With a vulnerability score of 74 out of 100, the seat is classified as “vulnerable.”
